title: Introduce init sidecar credential-refresh hook and compact values serializer
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Private installs running in air-gapped or VPC environments frequently require short-lived credentials to be refreshed during tenant bootstrap. Current init jobs embed secret material into long-lived init pods which complicates rotation and increases blast radius. This PR introduces a lightweight init-sidecar pattern for credential refresh plus a compact values serializer to reduce values.yaml payload size for large multi-tenant overlays. Summary of changes: 1) templates/credential-refresh-sidecar.yaml: new hook template implementing a sidecar that obtains credentials from the installer control plane or local KMS, writes them to an in-memory tmpfs path, and signals the main init job via a readiness file. The sidecar is purposely minimal (curl/kubectl optional) and supports both HTTP(K) and unix-socket KMS adapters via templated envs. 2) values.schema.json: extended with a small credentialRotation object (interval, jitterPercent, adapter, ttlFallback) and new compactSerializer boolean flag to enable the serializer by default for private installs. 3) helpers/_values-serializer.tpl: introduce templating helpers that compact arrays-of-maps into compacted map-of-strings to reduce Helm render time and values size when overlaying many tenant sections. 4) README-private.md: document the new rotation lifecycle, recommended adapter configurations, and upgrade steps. 5) chart tests: e2e helm template unit tests + small k8s job simulation yaml used in local CI. Compatibility and migration: the change is opt-in via values.compactSerializer=false for existing customers. When enabled, chart merges will prefer the compacted representation; the helper exposes a backward-compatible expand() helper for chart authors to opt-out. Security considerations: the sidecar writes credentials to tmpfs and sets strict file perms (0600) and closes file descriptors after signaling. The hook supports an HSM/KMS token exchange flow if provided; there are explicit timeouts and backoff policies to avoid blocking installs. Testing done: - Local helm template and unit tests (helm-unittest) - CI pipeline runs rendering across representative large overlays used by internal staging (500 tenants simulated) - A manual on-prem integration run in a staging VPC with image mirror and KMS adapter. Checklist: - [x] Add template and serializer helper - [x] Update values.schema.json and README - [x] Add unit and e2e tests - [x] Run internal staging render and smoke test - [x] Security review with SRE/security - [x] Add release notes entry Notes for operators: enabling credentialRotation without providing a reliable adapter will add latency to bootstrap; prefer short ttlFallback only when KMS is unavailable. Performance: compact serializer reduced rendered values payload size by ~48% in our 500-tenant staging run and dropped helm template time by ~35%. Rolling upgrade considerations: the hook uses helm pre-install/post-install hook annotations, respects hook-weight ordering and uses an idempotent readiness probe so a retryable install path is safe. Follow-ups: - Add optional leader-election when multiple init pods exist across tenant namespaces (future PR) - Wire-up automatic telemetry (metric: private.init.cred_refresh.duration) in Redwood Console (follow-up ENG-2201).

review_comments: Jordan Liu: Can the sidecar run as non-root and still write to the shared volume? Please ensure securityContext.runAsNonRoot and fsGroup are set.
Aisha Kapoor: Yes — sidecar is configured to run as non-root; securityContext added and tests validated. Added note in README about required PSP/PodSecurity admission settings.
Priya Nair: We should avoid any synchronous blocking of main init job if adapter is unreachable. Suggested exponential backoff + capped retries.
Aisha Kapoor: Implemented capped exponential backoff with a 5 minute total cap; documented behavior and set sensible defaults in values.schema.json.
Evan Brooks: Compact serializer is clever but might surprise ops if they edit rendered values. Add expand helpers and document upgrade steps.
Aisha Kapoor: Added expand() helper and migration notes in README-private.md; serializer defaults to false for minor releases to avoid surprises.

release_notes:
- Introduced init-sidecar credential refresh hook for private installs (opt-in via values.credentialRotation).
- Added compact values serializer to reduce values.yaml payloads in large multi-tenant overlays (opt-in).
- Security hardening for sidecar file handling and backoff defaults.
upgrade_instructions: To enable: set values.compactSerializer=true and configure values.credentialRotation.adapter and credentials. For staged rollout, enable compactSerializer in staging values first, then enable credentialRotation with a low frequency in canary namespaces. If using on-prem KMS adapter, ensure the adapter endpoint and TLS certs are available to init pods.
notes: This PR avoids adding any new cluster-level RBAC by keeping adapter communication scoped to tenant namespaces; operator docs include a recommended role binding pattern when using a centralized control plane adapter.
